title: Gold at a 20-day high in most other currencies but not in dollars
system: Stand-alone gold rule (XAU/USD), signal from gold in EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, AUD; not the live gold book

rule.signal: >= need of 5 non-USD gold prices close beyond their 20-day closing extreme while XAU/USD's does not: long (high) / short (low)
rule.stop: k x ATR(20) before the entry
rule.costs: $0.60 a trade + nights() x FIN.xau.long on buys

tests.what: 2 of 5 currencies, both sides, hold 5 candles, stop 2 x ATR(20) (primary)

placebo.how: signal days moved to random days of the same year, same side

control.how: each pair circularly shifted by its own random offset (>= 250 common days) against gold; signals rebuilt

tests.what: 3 of 5 currencies, both sides, hold 3 candles, stop 2 x ATR(20)

placebo.how: signal days moved to random days of the same year, same side

control.how: each pair circularly shifted by its own random offset (>= 250 common days) against gold; signals rebuilt

tests.what: 2 of 5 currencies, both sides, hold 3 candles, stop 2 x ATR(20)

placebo.how: signal days moved to random days of the same year, same side

control.how: each pair circularly shifted by its own random offset (>= 250 common days) against gold; signals rebuilt

headline: FAIL, 0 of 3: gold at a 20-day high (low) in 2 of 5 other currencies but not in dollars makes +0.066R a trade net 2017-26 (n 183, month t +1.11, Holm p 0.4); beats 29 of 40 placebos, 36 of 40 controls.
